title: Salary guidelines compliance in the social service sector
asked: The MP asked what percentage of social service agencies pay staff according to the NCSS Social Service Sector Salary Guidelines, and what measures support agencies that have not met the guidelines to close the wage gap.
answered_by: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
response: About 80% of employees in social service agencies are paid according to the NCSS Sector Skills and Salary Guidelines. MSF reviews and raises the guidelines so sector wages stay competitive, and adjusts programme funding so funded agencies can pay according to the latest guidelines, while agencies should also review their own operational budgets. Over the past three years MSF and NCSS have worked with agencies to improve adherence, engaging leaders on salary adherence and benchmarking them against peers, with further measures to come in the next few years.
